parsed.summary: The patch removes the unnecessary post_init signal handler for ImageField when width_field and height_field are not set, which should improve performance. The new tests cover the functionality.

issues.description: The patch introduces new files and structure that slightly deviate from the project's conventions, such as the use of AppConfig in the test setup.
